pages.quiz:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #15
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 120 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Zawadi is a Kiswahili name. What does it mean? (1 mark)
   A. A mountain
   B. A road
   C. A river
   D. A gift

2. Which is a healthy way to calm down when you feel angry? (1 mark)
   A. Shout at everyone
   B. Take deep breaths and count to ten
   C. Break things
   D. Hit the person

3. What should you do if you make a wrong choice? (1 mark)
   A. Admit it, say sorry and try to put it right
   B. Repeat it
   C. Blame others
   D. Hide it

4. Which is a result of a bad choice such as fighting? (1 mark)
   A. Better marks
   B. More friends
   C. Getting a prize
   D. Injury and punishment

5. Who is your cousin? (1 mark)
   A. Your father's father
   B. Your mother's sister
   C. Your teacher
   D. The child of your aunt or uncle

6. Which attribute comforts a child who is lonely? (1 mark)
   A. God is angry
   B. God is far away
   C. God is a loving Father who knows us by name
   D. God forgets us

7. Which action shows reverence for God? (1 mark)
   A. Laughing in church
   B. Talking during prayer
   C. Throwing the Bible
   D. Handling the Bible with care

8. Which verse says, "God is love"? (1 mark)
   A. Luke 19:5
   B. Acts 11:26
   C. Genesis 1:1
   D. 1 John 4:8

9. What does it mean to say that the Bible is inspired? (1 mark)
   A. God guided the writers so that their message is His word
   B. People invented it
   C. It was written in one day
   D. The writers copied other books

10. How did the crowd react when Jesus went to Zacchaeus' house? (1 mark)
   A. They were silent
   B. They grumbled
   C. They followed Zacchaeus
   D. They cheered

11. Why did people dislike tax collectors? (1 mark)
   A. They were farmers
   B. They were poor
   C. They were teachers
   D. Many took more money than they should

12. What does it mean to repent? (1 mark)
   A. To be sorry for sin and turn away from it
   B. To blame others
   C. To run away
   D. To pretend nothing happened

13. What is the meaning of "bless" in this story? (1 mark)
   A. To curse
   B. To speak good things over someone
   C. To insult
   D. To ignore

14. Which people ruled the Israelites during Samson's time? (1 mark)
   A. The Greeks
   B. The Philistines
   C. The Egyptians
   D. The Romans

15. Who had the dreams about seven cows and seven heads of grain? (1 mark)
   A. Pharaoh
   B. Potiphar
   C. Joseph
   D. Jacob

16. What is a patriarch? (1 mark)
   A. A king
   B. A soldier
   C. The father and leader of a family or nation
   D. A prophet

17. What was Sarai's name changed to? (1 mark)
   A. Rachel
   B. Sarah
   C. Rebekah
   D. Leah

18. Which quality of Mary should we copy? (1 mark)
   A. Greed
   B. Anger
   C. Trust in God and humility
   D. Pride

19. How did Zechariah get his speech back? (1 mark)
   A. After a healing by Jesus
   B. After a long sleep
   C. After visiting Jerusalem
   D. After writing "His name is John"

20. What does compassion mean? (1 mark)
   A. Ignoring others
   B. Laughing at others
   C. Feeling sorry for others and wanting to help
   D. Being angry

21. Which of these is a result of revenge? (1 mark)
   A. The problem gets bigger
   B. Peace grows
   C. Friendship grows
   D. Everyone is safe

22. What did Joseph say about what his brothers intended? (1 mark)
   A. You must pay
   B. You must leave
   C. You intended to harm me, but God intended it for good
   D. You are enemies

23. How many silver coins did the woman have? (1 mark)
   A. Ten
   B. Five
   C. Two
   D. Twelve

24. Which of these helps God's kingdom grow? (1 mark)
   A. Keeping quiet
   B. A good example and sharing the good news
   C. Ignoring church
   D. Being unkind

25. What is baptism? (1 mark)
   A. A journey
   B. A meal
   C. A dance
   D. A Christian act of washing with water in the name of Father, Son and Holy Spirit

26. What does repentance do? (1 mark)
   A. It makes us proud
   B. It pushes us away from God
   C. It draws us close to Christ
   D. It has no effect

27. Which of these is a sign of an unsafe secret? (1 mark)
   A. It makes you happy
   B. It makes you feel scared or uncomfortable
   C. It is about a game
   D. It is about a surprise gift

28. Who was obedient to his parents at Nazareth? (1 mark)
   A. Balaam
   B. Samson
   C. Jonah
   D. Jesus

29. What did Jesus do to the children? (1 mark)
   A. Gave them money
   B. Sent them home
   C. Ignored them
   D. Placed His hands on them and blessed them

30. Which action shows care for school property? (1 mark)
   A. Writing on desks
   B. Keeping toilets clean
   C. Breaking chairs
   D. Wasting water

31. Which of these is a way of serving God in church? (1 mark)
   A. Talking during prayers
   B. Leaving litter
   C. Breaking chairs
   D. Helping to clean

32. What did the first Christians devote themselves to? (1 mark)
   A. Travel
   B. Teaching, fellowship, breaking of bread and prayer
   C. Trading
   D. Fighting

33. What is a warning sign of an unsafe group? (1 mark)
   A. It welcomes you kindly
   B. It tells you to keep secrets from parents
   C. It encourages school work
   D. It teaches good manners

34. Which action shows goodness? (1 mark)
   A. Cheating
   B. Lying
   C. Stealing
   D. Returning extra change to a shopkeeper

35. What does patience mean? (1 mark)
   A. Waiting calmly without losing your temper
   B. Rushing
   C. Refusing to wait
   D. Being angry

36. Which fruit is shown by walking away instead of hitting back? (1 mark)
   A. Envy
   B. Greed
   C. Self-control
   D. Pride

37. What does defile mean? (1 mark)
   A. To praise
   B. To help
   C. To clean
   D. To make unclean or harm

38. Which verses in Galatians speak of self-control? (1 mark)
   A. Luke 1:37
   B. Galatians 5:22-25
   C. Genesis 1:1
   D. Acts 2:1

39. Why should you not chat with strangers online? (1 mark)
   A. They may not be who they say they are
   B. They are always kind
   C. It is fun
   D. It is free

40. Which of these is personal information to protect? (1 mark)
   A. A favourite song
   B. Your home address
   C. The colour of the sky
   D. The weather

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
41. Explain how the story of Balaam teaches obedience to God and respect for those in authority. (5 marks)

42. Describe what a child should do after sinning, in four steps. (4 marks)

43. Give three steps you can follow to make a right choice. (3 marks)

44. Give two sins that do not please God. (2 marks)

45. Explain what "born again" means. (2 marks)

46. Explain how children can help the needy at school, at home and in church. (5 marks)

47. Write the message of Luke 1:37 in your own words and describe a situation in which it can comfort a child. (4 marks)

48. State three rules for safe use of social media. (3 marks)

49. Name two things that can defile the body. (2 marks)

50. Explain why Zechariah was unable to speak. (3 marks)

51. Write the first two lines of the Lord's Prayer. (2 marks)

52. Explain how knowing that God is holy should affect the way a child behaves. (5 marks)

53. Explain how a child can show honour to parents in four ways. (4 marks)

54. Explain how Ephesians 4:25 can be applied by a child in the classroom. (5 marks)

55. State two lessons from the parable of the lost coin. (2 marks)

56. Explain how the books of the Old Testament are grouped, giving the number of books in each group. (5 marks)

57. Describe four ways in which a child can stand firm in their Christian faith. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #15 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — A gift
   Zawadi means a gift in Kiswahili.

2. B — Take deep breaths and count to ten
   Slowing down helps you to think before acting.

3. A — Admit it, say sorry and try to put it right
   Being honest about mistakes lets us make things right.

4. D — Injury and punishment
   Fighting often brings pain, trouble and lost friendships.

5. D — The child of your aunt or uncle
   Cousins are the children of your uncles and aunts.

6. C — God is a loving Father who knows us by name
   A loving Father cares and knows us.

7. D — Handling the Bible with care
   Care with God's word shows respect.

8. D — 1 John 4:8
   1 John 4:8 states that God is love.

9. A — God guided the writers so that their message is His word
   2 Timothy 3:16 teaches that Scripture is inspired by God.

10. B — They grumbled
   Luke 19:7 says they all began to mutter.

11. D — Many took more money than they should
   Many tax collectors cheated people.

12. A — To be sorry for sin and turn away from it
   Repentance includes turning away from wrong.

13. B — To speak good things over someone
   To bless is to ask God's good for someone.

14. B — The Philistines
   The Philistines oppressed Israel in the days of Samson.

15. A — Pharaoh
   Genesis 41 says that Pharaoh had the dreams.

16. C — The father and leader of a family or nation
   Abraham, Isaac and Jacob are called patriarchs.

17. B — Sarah
   Genesis 17:15 records this.

18. C — Trust in God and humility
   Mary trusted God and called herself the Lord's servant.

19. D — After writing "His name is John"
   His mouth was opened when he wrote the name.

20. C — Feeling sorry for others and wanting to help
   Compassion moves us to help.

21. A — The problem gets bigger
   Revenge starts a cycle of hurting.

22. C — You intended to harm me, but God intended it for good
   Genesis 50:20 records this.

23. A — Ten
   She had ten silver coins.

24. B — A good example and sharing the good news
   We help by our life and words.

25. D — A Christian act of washing with water in the name of Father, Son and Holy Spirit
   Baptism is a sign of new life.

26. C — It draws us close to Christ
   Repenting means turning to God for a new start.

27. B — It makes you feel scared or uncomfortable
   Bad secrets should be told to trusted adults.

28. D — Jesus
   Luke 2:51 says Jesus was obedient.

29. D — Placed His hands on them and blessed them
   Matthew 19:15 says He blessed them.

30. B — Keeping toilets clean
   Cleanliness respects property.

31. D — Helping to clean
   Cleaning is service.

32. B — Teaching, fellowship, breaking of bread and prayer
   Acts 2:42.

33. B — It tells you to keep secrets from parents
   Secrets from parents are a warning.

34. D — Returning extra change to a shopkeeper
   Goodness is doing what is right.

35. A — Waiting calmly without losing your temper
   Patience is calm waiting.

36. C — Self-control
   Self-control is controlling actions.

37. D — To make unclean or harm
   Defile means to harm or make unclean.

38. B — Galatians 5:22-25
   Galatians 5:22-25.

39. A — They may not be who they say they are
   People online can pretend.

40. B — Your home address
   Never share your address online.

SECTION B
----
41. (5 marks)
   Answer: God told Balaam what to say and do, and Balaam had to obey even though a king offered rewards. We should obey God's word and instructions from parents and teachers when they are good and right. Disobeying can put us in danger.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for God's instruction, 1 for the reward temptation, 1 for obedience to God, 1 for obeying parents and teachers, 1 for danger of disobedience.

42. (4 marks)
   Answer: Admit it, say sorry to God, say sorry to the person hurt, put things right, decide not to repeat.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each step up to 4.

43. (3 marks)
   Answer: Stop and think; ask if it agrees with God's word; think about who is helped or hurt; pray; ask a trusted adult.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid step, up to 3.

44. (2 marks)
   Answer: Lying, stealing, disobedience, bullying, jealousy.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

45. (2 marks)
   Answer: A new spiritual birth, a fresh start given by God through the Holy Spirit.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for new life and 1 for the Holy Spirit.

46. (5 marks)
   Answer: School: share a pencil or lunch, help a struggling classmate. Home: help with chores, give clothes that still fit. Church: take part in collections, visit the sick with parents.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each of school, home and church, and 2 marks for clear explanations.

47. (4 marks)
   Answer: Nothing is impossible with God. It can comfort a child who is afraid before an exam or when a family member is very sick, because God can help.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the meaning, 1 for a suitable situation, 2 for explaining how it comforts.

48. (3 marks)
   Answer: Ask permission, do not chat with strangers, do not share personal details, be kind, limit time.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each rule.

49. (2 marks)
   Answer: Alcohol, drugs, harmful media, sex outside marriage.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

50. (3 marks)
   Answer: He doubted the angel's message. The angel said that he would be silent until the baby was born because he did not believe.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for doubt, 1 for the angel's words, 1 for silence until it happened.

51. (2 marks)
   Answer: Our Father in heaven, hallowed be your name. (The wording "who art in heaven" is also accepted.)
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each line.

52. (5 marks)
   Answer: God is pure and never does wrong, so we should respect Him, worship Him and try to be holy. We should choose good things, tell the truth, avoid sin, behave well in church and obey His commandments. If we fail, we should say sorry.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for God being holy, 1 for respect, 1 for choosing good, 1 for avoiding sin or obeying, 1 for saying sorry.

53. (4 marks)
   Answer: Greet politely, obey cheerfully, help with chores, speak kindly, say thank you, pray for them.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid way up to 4.

54. (5 marks)
   Answer: Put off falsehood and speak truthfully because we are all members of one body. A child should not cheat, should admit mistakes, should not blame others, and should tell the teacher what really happened.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the verse meaning, 1 for not cheating, 1 for admitting mistakes, 1 for not blaming, 1 for telling the truth kindly.

55. (2 marks)
   Answer: Every person is precious to God; God searches for the lost; heaven rejoices when someone repents.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid lesson.

56. (5 marks)
   Answer: Law has 5 books, history has 12 books, poetry and wisdom has 5 books, and the prophets have 17 books. Together they make 39 books.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each group with number, and 1 mark for the total.

57. (4 marks)
   Answer: Pray, read the Bible, say no to wrong, be proud to be a Christian, join a good church group, ask God for courage.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each way up to 4.
